title: A Miktam of David

questions.question: Preserve me, O God, for in you I take what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:1 (ESV): "Preserve me, O God, for in you I take refuge."

questions.question: I say to the Lord, "You are my Lord; I have no what apart from you?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:2 (ESV): "I say to the Lord, 'You are my Lord; I have no good apart from you.'"

questions.question: The sorrows of those who run after another god shall do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:4 (ESV): "The sorrows of those who run after another god shall multiply;"

questions.question: The Lord is my chosen portion and my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:5 (ESV): "The Lord is my chosen portion and my cup; you hold my lot."

questions.question: You make known to me the path of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:11 (ESV): "You make known to me the path of life;"

questions.question: The lines have fallen for me in what kind of places?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:6 (ESV): "The lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, I have a beautiful inheritance."

questions.question: I bless the Lord who gives me what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:7 (ESV): "I bless the Lord who gives me counsel; in the night also my heart instructs me."

questions.question: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:8 (ESV): "I have set the Lord always before me; because he is at my right hand, I shall not be shaken."

questions.question: in your presence there is fullness of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:11 (ESV): "...in your presence there is fullness of joy;"

questions.question: at your right hand are pleasures when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:11 (ESV): "...at your right hand are pleasures forevermore."

questions.question: For you will not abandon my soul to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:10 (ESV): "For you will not abandon my soul to Sheol,"

questions.question: Or let your holy one see what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:10 (ESV): "...or let your holy one see corruption."

questions.question: As for the saints in the land, they are the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:3 (ESV): "As for the saints in the land, they are the excellent ones, in whom is all my delight."

questions.question: Their drink offerings of blood I will not pour out or take their names on my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:4 (ESV): "...or take their names on my lips."

questions.question: Therefore my heart is glad, and my whole being does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 16:9 (ESV): "Therefore my heart is glad, and my whole being rejoices; my flesh also dwells secure."

key_verse_text: You make known to me the path of life; in your presence there is fullness of joy; at your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
